entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A powerful angel, the living embodiment of hope and protection for humans, freed from imprisonment; under the influence of a strange buzzing and whispers she turns murderous and begins the great work.

entities.name: Macher
entities.description: A priest in a Gavony church, raised by the church, whose doubts about Avacyn are answered by a terrifying visit from her.

entities.name: Liont
entities.description: A smith cured of the werewolf curse by the Cursemute, who wakes to find he has slaughtered his family and is killed by an angel.

entities.name: Hilde
entities.description: Liont's wife, found dead on her bed.

entities.name: Talia
entities.description: Liont's daughter.

entities.name: Kan
entities.description: Liont's young son, a few years younger than Talia.

entities.name: Nickers
entities.description: A customer for whom Liont is making a plow.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who dwells in a tower solar in Kessig; sister of Bruna and Gisela, she refuses to accept Avacyn's new creed and resolves to fight.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An angel in blue and white light armor who wields a staff; Sigarda's sister, now speaking in Avacyn's voice.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: A tall angel of the Goldnight flight who wields twin blades; Sigarda's sister, now converted to Avacyn's cause.

entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: A mother and outsider from Kessig living in a village; Avacyn once saved her lost son, and Avacyn later kills her in the attack on her village.

entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: Kelse's young son, a spirited child who runs off exploring; he flees into the forest as the angels attack.

entities.name: Hanse
entities.description: Maeli's father, who has died.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The former lunarch, whom Macher once saw as a zombie.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane that has entered an age of prosperity and peace under Avacyn, until Avacyn turns on its people.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region of Innistrad whose high mountain passes are one of Avacyn's retreats.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region of Innistrad where Macher's church and Liont's smithy stand.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region of Innistrad with forests and an abandoned tower where Sigarda keeps her solar.

entities.name: Sigarda's Solar
entities.description: Sigarda's private chamber at the top of an abandoned tower in a Kessig forest.

entities.name: Church Courtyard
entities.description: A garden in the inner sanctum of the church in Gavony, with Avacyn's silver symbol at its center.

entities.name: Liont's House
entities.description: The house beside Liont's smithy, where his family lies slain.

entities.name: Kelse's Village
entities.description: The village where Kelse and Maeli live, attacked and burned by angels.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison in which many creatures of darkness were sealed, and in which Avacyn was rumored to have been imprisoned.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: A magical edict from Avacyn that gave werewolves the choice to become wolfir or, more rarely, be fully cured.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Werewolves transformed by the Cursemute into wolven servants and helpful allies of Avacyn.

entities.name: Angels of Innistrad
entities.description: The winged beings led by Avacyn, who protect humanity and, once Avacyn turns, begin attacking villages.

entities.name: Goldnight
entities.description: A flight of angels in red and white, led by Gisela.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The clergy that worships Avacyn and raised Macher.

entities.name: The Great Work
entities.description: Avacyn's plan to cleanse Innistrad of the impure, beginning with the slaughter of humans.

events.summary: Avacyn, hearing a mother's panicked prayer, leaves her mountain retreat and flies toward Gavony.
events.quote: Avacyn focused on the prayer, on the woman sending it to her, and saw an image of the woman running and sobbing in the middle of a large meadow.

events.summary: Avacyn finds the lost boy Maeli huddled in the crook of a tree after lighting up the forest and calling for him.
events.quote: Avacyn fixed the location of the child in her mind, and swooped over and down to a spot in the forest a few minutes away.

events.summary: Avacyn returns Maeli to his mother Kelse, and feels satisfied that this is why she exists.
events.quote: It took only moments for her to find the mother on the outskirts of the trees and give her the child.

events.summary: A violent shimmer racks Avacyn, doubling her vision and leaving a constant buzzing in her ears.
events.quote: A violent shimmer wracked her body, shaking her vision.

events.summary: Avacyn sees Kelse turn angry at Maeli and a thought comes to her that mortals are rotten, turning her view of the child from innocence to disgust.
events.quote: The seeds of men are rotten.

events.summary: Avacyn flees the scene, her mind consumed by the buzzing and the same words repeating.
events.quote: Avacyn fled, seeking refuge from her own mind.

events.summary: Macher, troubled by doubts about whether Avacyn is worthy of worship, prays for her to exist.
events.quote: Avacyn, please exist. Please be true.

events.summary: Avacyn descends into the church courtyard before Macher.
events.quote: Macher whirled, his mouth agape, and saw an angel descend.

events.summary: Avacyn accuses Macher of doubting, mocks his claim to be pure, and asks whether she has lost faith in him.
events.quote: You prayed to me because you doubted.

events.summary: Terrified, Macher collapses; Avacyn whispers 'Soon' and vanishes, leaving him certain of the true nature of his god.
events.quote: He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.

events.summary: Liont, cured of lycanthropy by the Cursemute, wakes to an ordinary-seeming day while his wife and children repeat a warning not to open the door when it is knocked.
events.quote: Liont. When the door is knocked, do not open it.

events.summary: Liont opens the door in his mind and sees his house as it truly is, bloody, with Hilde dead on the bed.
events.quote: He looked at the body of Hilde, her face frozen in terror as she lay unmoving on the bed.

events.summary: Liont realizes he is the one who did this, despite believing he was free of the curse, and prays to Avacyn.
events.quote: Who had done this? He knew who had done this.

events.summary: A winged figure, perhaps Avacyn, blasts the roof off and strikes Liont with a lance of energy.
events.quote: She pointed her spear at him, and the tip grew bright, brighter, brighter than the sun overhead, and a lancing energy struck him in the chest, burning away clothes and skin.

events.summary: Refusing his plea for mercy, the angel kills Liont.
events.quote: and then he died.

events.summary: Sigarda, uneasy at a storm of lightning without thunder, is joined in her solar by her sisters Bruna and Gisela, who are armed and behave strangely.
events.quote: Tall Gisela, cloaked in the red and white of her Goldnight flight, her twin blades already out of their sheaths.

events.summary: Avacyn lands in Sigarda's solar, her speech slurred, her spear twisted and her eyes flashing black.
events.quote: As the thunder subsided, Avacyn landed in the solar.

events.summary: Avacyn announces that the great work is soon to begin.
events.quote: The great work is soon to be underway.

events.summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
events.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

events.summary: Avacyn argues that humans are as guilty as the monsters angels fight and must be punished.
events.quote: For their crimes we have sought to punish and kill.

events.summary: Avacyn says Bruna and Gisela have come around to her view, and the two echo her words.
events.quote: It took Bruna and Gisela some time to understand as well.

events.summary: Avacyn obliterates the stone roof of the solar with a surge of power and departs with Bruna and Gisela.
events.quote: A surge of power leapt from the spear, and the roof...vanished.

events.summary: Sigarda resolves to fight Avacyn, even alone.
events.quote: This time I fight.

events.summary: Kelse searches for Maeli, who has run off again, and recalls how Avacyn saved him months ago.
events.quote: Kelse tried hard not to think of a few months ago, when he had run off.

events.summary: Angels appear over Kelse's village and begin killing villagers with spears, swords and fire.
events.quote: Then one of the angels pointed her glowing spear downward at the village.

events.summary: Kelse orders Maeli to run into the forest and not look back.
events.quote: Run! Run now, the fastest you have ever run! To the forest!

events.summary: Kelse prays to Avacyn for help and finds that Avacyn herself, dressed in black with blood-red wings, is leading the destruction.
events.quote: You do not need to pray your lies to me, creature. I'm right here in front of you.

events.summary: Avacyn declares the great work has begun and says she will find Maeli eventually.
events.quote: I will find the small creature eventually.

events.summary: Avacyn kills Kelse with her spear and watches her ashes blow away.
events.quote: Avacyn watched as the remains of the mortal creature blew away, the ashes scattering and swirling for a moment of flight before falling to the ground.

events.summary: Avacyn hears the sky, rivers, trees and moon whisper a single truth and believes she now listens to truth, not liars.
events.quote: All whispered glorious truth.

relations.note: The Cursemute is her magical edict.
Werewolves who chose to become her servants.
She leads the angels but is not of them.
relations.quote: Avacyn led them, but was not of them.

relations.note: Rumored to have been imprisoned in the Helvault and then freed.
relations.quote: imprisoned in the very Helvault in which so many creatures of darkness had been sealed away

relations.note: Raised by the church from toddlerhood and a priest.
relations.quote: He had been fed by the church and clothed by the church and protected by the church

relations.note: Macher knew Mikaeus, the former lunarch, and saw him as a zombie.
relations.quote: Macher had known Mikaeus, the former lunarch
Go back to sleep, my daughter.
He tarried briefly on the other side of the bed to say goodbye to his son.

relations.note: Implied: Liont, in werewolf form, killed his family; only Hilde's body is described.
relations.quote: Who had done this? He knew who had done this.

relations.note: The angel who strikes him down is perhaps Avacyn herself.
Angel sisters, not truly sisters in the human sense but of the same essence.
relations.quote: Gisela, Bruna, and Sigarda weren't truly sisters, not in any way that the word described humans.

relations.note: Angel sisters of the same essence.
relations.quote: But they had come from the same essence, the same dawn times

relations.note: Gisela is cloaked in the colors of her Goldnight flight.
relations.quote: Tall Gisela, cloaked in the red and white of her Goldnight flight
But Avacyn had come, had saved her child, her only child.

relations.note: Avacyn burns her with her spear in the destroyed village.
relations.quote: All will burn. All will bleed.
